title: Specify a single continuous 30-second sequence and include a second-by-second…
content:
Specify a single continuous 30-second sequence and include a second-by-second timeline (e.g., [0.0s–4.0s], [4.0s–8.0s]) to control shot progression and pacing.  
Lock realism by adding camera/lens/exposure details like ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 40mm, T2.0, shallow DOF, 24fps, 180-degree shutter.  
Direct camera motion explicitly (e.g., handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake, whip-pan, low tracking shot, slow arc, dolly-in, push-in) to avoid generic “floating camera” movement.  
Force character consistency by stating “consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds” to reduce identity drift.  
Anchor lighting with specific motivated sources (near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green) and add volumetric haze/particulates/condensation for cinematic depth.  
Define a color grade recipe (desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain) to stabilize the look across the clip.  
Describe creature motion behavior patterns (freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging) to get more readable, intentional animation.  
Include an explicit “quality anchor” section (photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping) to push fidelity and continuity.  
Use a targeted negative prompt list (cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting) to suppress common failure modes.  
Add an SFX list (servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble) to guide audio generation or sound design alignment with the visuals.

es.content:
Especifica una única secuencia continua de 30 segundos e incluye una línea de tiempo segundo a segundo (por ejemplo, [0.0s–4.0s], [4.0s–8.0s]) para controlar la progresión de los planos y el ritmo.  
Fija el realismo añadiendo detalles de cámara/lente/exposición como ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 40mm, T2.0, shallow DOF, 24fps, 180-degree shutter.  
Dirige explícitamente el movimiento de cámara (por ejemplo, handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake, whip-pan, low tracking shot, slow arc, dolly-in, push-in) para evitar un movimiento genérico de “floating camera”.  
Asegura la consistencia del personaje indicando “consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds” para reducir la deriva de identidad.  
Ancla la iluminación con fuentes motivadas específicas (near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green) y añade volumetric haze/particulates/condensation para lograr profundidad cinematográfica.  
Define una receta de color grading (desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain) para estabilizar el aspecto a lo largo del clip.  
Describe patrones de comportamiento del movimiento de la criatura (freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging) para obtener una animación más legible e intencional.  
Incluye una sección explícita de “quality anchor” (photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping) para potenciar la fidelidad y la continuidad.  
Usa una lista de negative prompt específica (cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting) para suprimir fallos comunes.  
Añade una lista de SFX (servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble) para guiar la generación de audio o la alineación del sound design con lo visual.

Verrouillez le réalisme en ajoutant des détails de caméra/objectif/exposition comme ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 40mm, T2.0, shallow DOF, 24fps, 180-degree shutter.  
Dirigez explicitement le mouvement de caméra (par ex. handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake, whip-pan, low tracking shot, slow arc, dolly-in, push-in) afin d’éviter un mouvement générique de “floating camera”.  
Assurez la cohérence du personnage en indiquant “consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds” pour réduire la dérive d’identité.  
Ancrez l’éclairage avec des sources motivées spécifiques (near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green) et ajoutez volumetric haze/particulates/condensation pour une profondeur cinématographique.  
Définissez une recette de color grading (desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain) pour stabiliser l’apparence sur tout le clip.  
Décrivez les schémas de mouvement de la créature (freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging) afin d’obtenir une animation plus lisible et intentionnelle.  
Incluez une section explicite “quality anchor” (photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping) pour renforcer la fidélité et la continuité.  
Utilisez une liste ciblée de negative prompt (cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting) pour supprimer les modes d’échec courants.  
Ajoutez une liste SFX (servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble) pour guider la génération audio ou l’alignement du sound design avec les visuels.

ja.content:
単一の連続した30秒シーケンスを指定し、秒ごとのタイムライン（例：[0.0s–4.0s]、[4.0s–8.0s]）を含めて、ショットの進行とテンポを制御します。  
ARRI Alexa 35、anamorphic 40mm、T2.0、浅いDOF、24fps、180-degree shutter などの camera/lens/exposure の詳細を追加して、リアリズムを固定します。  
handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake、whip-pan、low tracking shot、slow arc、dolly-in、push-in などで camera motion を明示的に指示し、一般的な「floating camera」的な動きを避けます。  
“consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds” と明記してキャラクターの一貫性を強制し、identity drift を抑えます。  
near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green のような、動機づけのある具体的な光源で lighting を固定し、cinematic な奥行きを出すために volumetric haze/particulates/condensation を加えます。  
desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain のような color grade recipe を定義して、クリップ全体の見た目を安定させます。  
creature motion の挙動パターン（freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging）を記述して、より読み取りやすく意図のある animation を得ます。  
明示的な “quality anchor” セクション（photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping）を含めて、fidelity と continuity を高めます。  
targeted negative prompt list（cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting）を使って、よくある失敗を抑制します。  
SFX list（servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble）を追加して、audio generation または sound design を映像に合わせて誘導します。

ko.content:
단일한 30초 연속 시퀀스를 지정하고, 샷 진행과 페이싱을 제어하기 위해 초 단위 타임라인(예: [0.0s–4.0s], [4.0s–8.0s])을 포함하세요.  
ARRI Alexa 35, anamorphic 40mm, T2.0, shallow DOF, 24fps, 180-degree shutter 같은 카메라/렌즈/노출 세부 정보를 추가해 realism을 고정하세요.  
handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake, whip-pan, low tracking shot, slow arc, dolly-in, push-in 같은 표현으로 카메라 움직임을 명시적으로 지시해, 일반적인 “floating camera” 움직임을 피하세요.  
“consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds”라고 명시해 캐릭터 일관성을 강제하고 identity drift를 줄이세요.  
near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green 같은 구체적인 동기화된 광원을 사용해 조명을 고정하고, cinematic depth를 위해 volumetric haze/particulates/condensation을 추가하세요.  
desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain 같은 color grade recipe를 정의해 클립 전반의 룩을 안정화하세요.  
freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging 같은 creature motion behavior patterns를 설명해 더 읽기 쉽고 의도적인 애니메이션을 얻으세요.  
“quality anchor” 섹션(photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping)을 명시적으로 포함해 fidelity와 continuity를 높이세요.  
cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting 같은 targeted negative prompt list를 사용해 흔한 실패 모드를 억제하세요.  
servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble 같은 SFX 목록을 추가해 오디오 생성이나 사운드 디자인이 비주얼과 맞도록 유도하세요.

Garanta a consistência do personagem afirmando “consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds” para reduzir a deriva de identidade.  
Aterre a iluminação com fontes motivadas específicas (near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green) e adicione volumetric haze/particulates/condensation para profundidade cinematográfica.  
Defina uma receita de color grade (desaturated steel-blue shadows, amber practicals, crushed blacks, fine 35mm grain) para estabilizar a aparência ao longo do clipe.  
Descreva padrões de comportamento do movimento da criatura (freeze → twitch → explosive lunge; ceiling/wall clinging) para obter uma animação mais legível e intencional.  
Inclua uma seção explícita de “quality anchor” (photorealistic feature-film quality, physically accurate lighting/reflections, natural motion blur, consistent scale, no morphing/warping) para elevar a fidelidade e a continuidade.  
Use uma lista direcionada de negative prompt (cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene, plastic textures, floating camera, slow motion, text/watermark, extra limbs/duplicates, bright flat lighting) para suprimir modos de falha comuns.  
Adicione uma lista de SFX (servo whine, hydraulic hiss, breathing, weapon discharge reverb, door grind, sub-rumble) para orientar a geração de áudio ou o design de som em alinhamento com os visuais.

zh.content:
指定一个单一、连续的 30 秒序列，并包含逐秒时间线（例如 [0.0s–4.0s]、[4.0s–8.0s]），以控制镜头推进和节奏。  
通过加入相机/镜头/曝光细节来锁定真实感，例如 ARRI Alexa 35、anamorphic 40mm、T2.0、浅景深、24fps、180-degree shutter。  
明确指示镜头运动（例如 handheld operator camera with reactive micro-shake、whip-pan、low tracking shot、slow arc、dolly-in、push-in），以避免笼统的“floating camera”运动。  
通过写明“consistent identical armor design, damage pattern and lighting across all 30 seconds”来强制角色一致性，以减少身份漂移。  
用具体且有动机的光源来锚定光照（near-total darkness + shoulder floodlight + red emergency strobes + cold bioluminescent green），并加入 volumetric haze/particulates/condensation 以增强电影感深度。  
定义一套 color grade 配方（desaturated steel-blue shadows、amber practicals、crushed blacks、fine 35mm grain），以稳定整段视频的视觉风格。  
描述生物运动行为模式（freeze → twitch → explosive lunge；ceiling/wall clinging），以获得更清晰、更有意图的动画表现。  
加入明确的“quality anchor”部分（photorealistic feature-film quality、physically accurate lighting/reflections、natural motion blur、consistent scale、no morphing/warping），以提升真实度和连续性。  
使用有针对性的 negative prompt 列表（cartoon/3D render/video game cutscene、plastic textures、floating camera、slow motion、text/watermark、extra limbs/duplicates、bright flat lighting）来抑制常见失败模式。  
添加一份 SFX 列表（servo whine、hydraulic hiss、breathing、weapon discharge reverb、door grind、sub-rumble），以指导音频生成或让 sound design 与视觉保持一致。
